title: Minigames count down to a party

quote: 5 days until the party
location: End-of-night minigames, opening captions (pre-Night 1 through post-Night 5)

when.label: c. 1983 — 5 to 0 days before the party
when.basis: The 'Fredbear & Friends!' broadcast on the TV in the post-Night 3 minigame displays '1983'; the minigames are a countdown of days to the child's birthday party. The TV date dates the show, so the minigame year is approximate.

notes: Captions in sequence: '5 days until the party', '4 days…', '3 days…', '2 days…', '1 day until the party.', '0 days until the party.'
